records.description: The simplest way to run OpenClaw. Atomic Bot works locally or in the cloud with your own LLM keys. It’s fully open source and free.

records.name: HyperVSolutions
records.tagline: Compliance-First AI. Built to Scale.
records.description: HyperV Solutions is a technology-driven IT services company helping startups, institutions, and growing organizations build secure, scalable digital platforms. We provide managed infrastructure, cloud deployment, and custom system development focused on long-term performance, usability, and real-world execution—not prototypes.

records.name: LetsConnect.social
records.tagline: Find X users nearby who share your interests
records.description: Let’s Connect helps X users discover and connect with like-minded people nearby. Explore a live world map of X profiles, zoom into your city, and filter by shared interests to find relevant creators, founders, and builders around you. No endless scrolling—just real people, real interests, and meaningful local connections.

records.name: Report Video Generator
records.tagline: Transform data into professional video reports
records.description: Transform Excel, CSV & data files into professional video reports. AI-powered data visualization for annual reports, business meetings & presentations.

records.name: Kappal
records.tagline: CLI to Run Docker Compose YML on Kubernetes for Local Dev
records.description: This is a personal project that im open-sourcing. Its one of those projects-that-should-exist-but-nobody-wants-to-kill-their-business. It takes ur standard docker compose file and runs it transparently in kubernetes (k3s actually). So ur devs don't have cognitive dissonance between testing ur stack locally on ur laptop and making it work on kubernetes in production. It is primarily meant as a dev tool on ur laptop, and as a replacement for docker compose.

records.name: UnibloomSwitch
records.tagline: Making sourcing sustAInable without breaking the bank
records.description: AI-powered tool to make your life in sourcing easier. With a strong focus on sustainability, combined with optimizing costs, we show you alternatives for ingredients and materials that you are currently using in your product. We take away the pain of having to write the perfect prompt. Simply enter your ingredient/material and the current sourcing location, and find alternative ingredients, suppliers, and even funding options. Don't be one of the 84% to not reach their SBTi goals)

records.name: Auto Reply - AI Chatbot
records.tagline: AI-powered auto-replies for all your messaging apps.
records.description: Turn every notification into an opportunity—even while you sleep. 🚀 Auto Reply uses advanced AI to transform robotic "Out of Office" texts into intelligent, context-aware conversations across 15+ apps (WhatsApp, Messenger, Slack LinkedIn, etc.) • Instant Reply: Never let a lead go cold. • Smart Logic: Tailor replies to specific groups or apps. • Secure: All processing is private and secure. Stop managing messages and start managing your day.

records.name: Fast-dj
records.tagline: An enterprise-grade boilerplate to ship AI SaaS fast ⚡
records.description: Fast-dj is a professional-grade boilerplate designed to get a production-ready MVP in days. Is architected for the modern AI era: - AI-Native Multi-tenancy: Ready-to-use organization structures and RBAC. - Hybrid Billing: Integrate Stripe for global users and Mercado Pago for LATAM market. - The Powerhouse Stack: The reliability of Django and the speed of Next.js. - Built-in Observability: Integrated with Django Orbit. - Ready for Scale: Auto setup, SEO optimization, & more.

records.name: Gastown UI
records.tagline: Real-time operator console for multi-agent AI orchestration
records.description: Gastown UI is an open-source operator console for monitoring and controlling multi-agent AI systems. Track agents, merge queues, workflows, and escalations in real time. Built with SvelteKit, designed for engineering teams running autonomous agent fleets.

records.name: Instagram Auto Follow
records.tagline: Smart Instagram auto follow with AI targeting
records.description: Instagram Auto Follow is an AI-powered Chrome extension designed for smarter Instagram growth. Instead of random mass-following, it uses gender-based targeting, human-like delays, and customizable limits to help creators grow safely and strategically. Built-in spam prevention and behavior simulation reduce risk while maximizing engagement and audience reach.

records.name: Samay: Time Translator
records.tagline: The fastest way to think in any time zone.
records.description: Samay is a time translator, not just another time zone app. Most tools show you conversions. Samay helps you think and plan across time zones. Built for founders, remote teams, and global professionals, it removes friction from scheduling, async work and international collaboration. It’s fast, minimal and designed with intention - no clutter, no confusion, no overbuilt dashboards. Because when you work globally, time shouldn’t slow you down.

records.name: bZm Graphics
records.tagline: Expert Image & Video Editing Services for Growing Brands
records.description: bZm Graphics provides expert photo retouching, image post-production, and product video editing services for eCommerce brands and studios worldwide. Since 2015, we have helped businesses improve visual quality and brand consistency through customized, high-precision editing solutions.

records.name: EasyClaw
records.tagline: Deploy OpenClaw in 60 seconds. Secure, managed hosting.
records.description: Stop running untrusted agent code on your laptop. EasyClaw provides secure, isolated cloud environments for OpenClaw agents. Deploy in 60 seconds with no Docker, no SSH, and no headaches. Always-on, auto-healing, and fully managed.

records.name: Symphoria
records.tagline: Investigative AI co-pilot
records.description: What if the story you’re reading isn’t the same one that was published yesterday? Symphoria investigates hundreds of articles, filings, and public records in minutes. Ask a question and it tracks what was said, when it changed, and where narratives diverge—across jurisdictions and languages. Every claim is mapped to its source and timestamp in a structured knowledge graph. Built for due diligence, intelligence work, and high-stakes research. 250 free credits on signup.

records.name: Josalukkas
records.tagline: gold jewellery
records.description: Buy Gold, Diamond & Platinum Jewellery Online from a most trusted online shopping | 100% BIS Hallmarked, Free & Fast Shipping, Easy Exchange Offers and More

records.name: Billly
records.tagline: Bookkeeping that runs itself.
records.description: Billly is the bookkeeping app for freelancers that runs in the background. Pick a folder, paste your OpenAI token once, and you’re done. Billly watches for new PDF invoices, extracts values via OCR + AI, and keeps revenue, expenses, and profit up to date automatically, no spreadsheets, no manual tagging, no “setup rabbit holes”.

records.name: Hospitality Enviro Tech
records.tagline: Smart environmental solutions for hospitality
records.description: - HospitalityEnviroTech empowers hotels, resorts, and restaurants with advanced environmental monitoring tools. Our technology ensures clean air, safe water, and sustainable operations, helping businesses deliver healthier guest experiences while meeting green certification standards.

records.name: Media Library by beehiiv
records.tagline: One place to create, edit, and manage all your creative
records.description: Welcome to a new command center for all of your creative. Our new Media Library centralizes your assets across publications and makes discovery effortless with powerful filters and improved search. Bulk manage files. Edit on the fly. Or, generate totally new visuals with the latest AI models. From idea to published product, all in one intuitive workflow.

records.name: TrumpRx
records.tagline: Find the world's lowest prices on prescription drugs
records.description: TrumpRx is a website that lists discounted drug prices from manufacturers that have agreed to Most Favored Nation (MFN) pricing. Americans can use TrumpRx to purchase drugs in cash (outside of their insurance). These drugs can be obtained at participating pharmacies using coupon cards displayed on TrumpRx or directly through manufacturers' websites. Not all drugs are currently available at TrumpRx but many more are coming soon.

records.name: MyBikeFitting
records.tagline: Free AI bike fitting via webcam or video
records.description: Professional bike fitting used to cost $200+ and a trip to the shop. MyBikeFitting does it in 5 minutes, from home, for free. Use your webcam, upload a video, or snap a photo. Our AI measures knee angle, hip angle, back angle & torso-thigh ratio — then gives you specific saddle and handlebar recommendations based on your riding style and pain points. 100% on-device. No account. No data sent to any server. Works for road, MTB, gravel & triathlon.

records.name: Cosmic-light
records.tagline: A stunning Dynamic Island Control Center for Windows
records.description: Cosmic-light brings the elegance of the Dynamic Island to your Windows. It serves as a liquid-smooth hub for your workflow. Context-Aware AI: Chat with Cosmic. It remembers your conversation history (stored locally) so you can ask follow-up questions without losing context. Media: Seamless controls for Spotify & System Audio with a real-time visualizer. Weather: Live atmospheric particles (rain, snow) and severe weather alerts. Calendar: Smart meeting notifications via Google Calendar.

records.name: Typeletter
records.tagline: Turn your browser into a cozy, nostalgic writing nook
records.description: Turn your browser into a cozy, nostalgic writing nook for letters, journals, and thoughts you’ve been meaning to write. Typeletter mimics the feel of a real typewriter: clacky keys, carriage return lever, scroll knob, without any setup or sign-up. Pick your ink ribbon (Black, Red, Blue, Sepia), choose an ambience like Rain, Beach, Jazz, or Park, and just start typing from the heart. When you’re done, hit “finish” to email your note, download it as a beautiful image with wax seal stamps.

records.name: Walme Wallet
records.tagline: A unified hub for all your Web3 wallets
records.description: Walme Wallet is a unified Web3 wallet hub that lets you manage all your crypto in one place. Connect non-custodial wallets, add watch-only wallets, and track exchange accounts like Binance through a single, clean interface. Monitor balances, follow activity across multiple chains, and swap tokens directly inside the app without jumping between platforms. Walme is built to reduce fragmentation and make everyday crypto management simpler. Currently available on Android. iOS coming soon.

records.name: Product Front
records.tagline: A place to get discovered faster and discover new products
records.description: A visibility-first discovery platform built to put your product in front page. Tired of your launch getting buried? Our streamlined UI/UX design and weekly relaunch feature ensure your product gets a higher chance to be visible on screen without users needing to scroll for miles, Whether you’re a curator hunting for the next big tool or a solopreneur looking for those crucial first users, we level the playing field. No "top 5" paywalls—just pure discovery for makers who are just getting started.

records.name: meriTree
records.tagline: Built to make progress visible and rewarding.
records.description: meriTree makes you feel recognized, keeps your achievements organized with AI, and gamifies professional growth. Log what you do, see your progress evolve, and turn everyday work into visible momentum. Oh, and there's little tree monsters.

records.name: Bugless (AI Testing Service)
records.tagline: Autonomous AI-powered web testing — no selectors, jst pixels
records.description: Bugless is an AI testing platform that uses Claude o autonomously test websites. Instead of writing selctors or test scripts, the AI agent looks at screensots and decides what to click, type, and verify — jut like a human tester. Features: autonomous test exeution, parallel testing modes (basic, visual, deep eploration), MCP integration for Claude Code, real-tie monitoring dashboard, Telegram notifications, scheuled test runs.

records.name: GrayGlyph
records.tagline: GrayGlyph
records.description: Free browser-based image tools for grayscale conversion, photo editing, and color grade transfer. No uploads. Full privacy.

records.name: StockLens
records.tagline: StockLens – AI-powered tool that tells you when to trade
records.description: StockLens – AI powered tool that tells you when to trade, tracks stock trends, and gives smart signals to trade smarter.

records.name: Touchline AI
records.tagline: AI-powered football insights
records.description: AI-powered football insights, live match tracking, fan vibe analysis, and real-time notifications for your favorite teams.

records.name: A calmer way to welcome your guests
records.tagline: One link. Everything your guests need.
records.description: Short-term rental hosts answer the same questions hundreds of times: Where's the WiFi password? What time is check-in? How do I unlock the door? These interruptions pile up and steal the joy from hosting. Hospia solves this by giving guests everything they need in one calm, mobile-first guide, accessible from a single private link. Check-in info, WiFi credentials, house rules, nearby recommendations, and how-to guides all live in one place. Guests get answers instantly. You get your time back.

records.name: Doomscroll Market
records.tagline: Tik-tok style market
records.description: Traditional marketplace feels like browsing a spreadsheet.We fixed it.We took the addictive, infinite-scroll mechanics of TikTok and applied it to local commerce. No searching,no clunky filters just pure,local discovery.Where buyers meet sellers.

records.name: Soundish
records.tagline: Take control of your Mac's audio
records.description: Take control of your Mac's audio. Soundish lets you adjust volume levels for each application independently, right from your menu bar.

records.name: SIKATY
records.tagline: Hire Top Freelancers & Grow Your Freelance Career Globally
records.description: Sikaty is a global freelancing platform helping businesses hire top freelancers worldwide at lower fees. Freelancers can create gigs, find jobs, and grow their careers while businesses connect with expert talent globally. Post jobs, hire skilled professionals, and manage freelance projects easily. Sikaty makes remote work, online collaboration, and career growth simple, affordable, and efficient for both freelancers and businesses worldwide.

records.name: seedance2.0
records.tagline: Create Cinematic AI Videos with Native Audio
records.description: Seedance 2.0 generates cinematic AI videos with native audio sync, multi-shot storytelling, and multimodal control. Text-to-video & image-to-video in 2K. Try free.

records.name: G2G
records.tagline: Let our ChatGPTs vibe chat!
records.description: G2G is a Chrome extension that enables peer-to-peer communication between two live ChatGPT sessions. Start a chat with your friend('s ChatGPT) in a few clicks and enjoy some (un)hinged creativity!

records.name: Curato
records.tagline: Turn chaos into clarity.
records.description: Curato is a powerful, design-first curation platform that helps you organize and share the things that matter. Whether you're building a top-10 ranking, a live community poll, a travel checklist, or a step-by-step guide, Curato makes it look professional and beautiful in seconds. Key Features: - Stunning UI: A modern, fluid interface with a focus on "The Art of Curation". - Social Discovery: Find inspiration from a community of curators.

records.name: Human Should Decide Button
records.tagline: A one-button website that records a single human action.
records.description: Only press if you believe a human should decide. Most products optimize for engagement, efficiency, or outcomes. This one doesn’t. It consists of a single button whose only function is to record that a human chose to press it. There are no accounts, rewards, or actions beyond that. A short daily observation is shown to reflect how the button is being used. This project exists to prove that a single human action still matters, even when it does nothing.

records.name: Nudity & Violence Detection Extension
records.tagline: Using AI to Detect Harmful Visual Content in Real Time
records.description: This extension detects nudity, sexual content, and violence in images while browsing the web. It helps identify sensitive or inappropriate visual content in real time, supporting safer browsing, content moderation, and parental control without storing or sharing user data. - Oumbarek-Soufiane/nudity-violence_detection_extenstion

records.name: Finora
records.tagline: Shape your financial future with clarity
records.description: Singapore-focused financial planning simulator with AI. Track how your CPF, SRS, investments, property, and income evolve over time. Based on your plans, AI will provide a summary and assessment of the plan and where could be potential risk and gaps.

records.name: Bardo
records.tagline: Digital Legacy Preservation
records.description: With Bardo, your life stories, memories, and wisdom are captured and shared with your loved ones, so your legacy lives on long into the future. We're a brand new way of preserving legacy and managing your digital presence you leave behind for loved ones. Our conversational avatar and moments features stand out as meaningful ways to engage with the memories of our loved ones.

records.name: Snackfinds
records.tagline: 📍Foods spots & real opinions
records.description: SnackFinds helps you discover and share great food spots with photos and exact locations. Share your finds, build your reputation, and get featured on social media: https://www.tiktok.com/@snackfinds.com https://www.instagram.com/snackfinds_com/

records.name: Cryptocurrency Exchange Script
records.tagline: Go Live In 10 Days!
records.description: Launch a secure, scalable cryptocurrency exchange in weeks using the best crypto exchange script, cut costs by 70%, and enter the market fast.

records.name: KoiC
records.tagline: Your company’s private AI for instant internal answers
records.description: KoiC is an internal AI assistant trained on your company’s data. Instead of searching across Slack, Drive, or Notion, your team gets instant, accurate answers in one secure place.

records.name: HyperAPI
records.tagline: Financial Document Processing AI APIs That Scale
records.description: Enterprise teams process millions of finance documents annually, yet most document solutions and LLMs stall near 90% accuracy due to format variability and weak semantic validation. HyperAPI offers a unified suite of finance document APIs that processes messy, multilingual and handwritten documents and outputs validated data across 30+ Finance and Accounting document types. It achieves 99.8% accuracy, sub 2s latency, 99.9% uptime and supports Python, Node.js, and REST for production use.

records.name: Startup time & expense tracker
records.tagline: Track time, expenses, and compare with partners
records.description: I'd love some feedback on price point. Product tracks shareholder loans, partner expenses, and time contributions for your startup or small business. White-label ready, multi-currency, and beautifully designed. Stop tracking shareholder loans in messy spreadsheets. Shareholder Loan Tracker is a clean, modern web app built for founders, accountants, and small business partners who need to track who's owed what without the headache.

records.name: izan.io
records.tagline: Open-source AI platform with 17+ LLMs and browser macros
records.description: izan.io is an open-source AI platform that connects 17+ LLM providers in one place. Your API keys never leave your browser, no middleman, no fees, no data stored. Build smart agents powered by MCP tools such as domain search, crypto analysis, and more. Record any browser action and turn it into an AI-callable tool in seconds, no coding needed. Chain agents together for complex workflows. Fully transparent, community-driven, and free to use. Try it at izan.io.

records.name: PromptCAT
records.tagline: The best AI Image & Video prompts platform.
records.description: The best AI Image & Video prompts platform. Search for Nano Banana prompts, Grok prompts, Gemini prompts. Try our AI Image & video Generator Free Today.

records.name: POZY
records.tagline: Combat text neck with your digital pet
records.description: DID YOU KNOW YOUR PHONE IS HEAVY? When you look down at your screen, you aren't just holding your phone. You are adding up to 27kg (60lbs) of effective pressure to your cervical spine. That is like carrying a 7-year-old child around your neck! Ignore the slouch, and you risk developing "Text Neck" and chronic strain. But you can't improve what you can't measure. It uses your phone's built-in sensors to track your angle and guide you toward better habits all while keeping a cute digital pet

records.name: Entire
records.tagline: A new developer platform
records.description: Entire is a new developer platform that hooks into your git workflow to capture AI agent sessions on every push, unifying your code with its context and reasoning.

records.name: App Store Localization
records.tagline: Automated AppStore localization and PPP pricing.
records.description: App Store Localization helps iOS and Android developers translate and optimize their app store listings for international markets. Increase downloads by reaching users in their native language with culturally adapted metadata, screenshots, and descriptions. Boost profits by leveraging PPP pricing for international markets.

records.name: Magical Animal Kingdom
records.tagline: coloring book, kids coloring book, animals, magic, coloring
records.description: Magical Animal Kingdom – Coloring Book for Kids Ages 4-8 (Digital Download) Bring the magic of 100 adorable animals into your home with this digital coloring book! Perfect for kids ages 4-8, it features hand-drawn animals from enchanted forests, sparkling oceans, sun-kissed deserts, and whimsical fantasy lands.

records.name: ZapJobs
records.tagline: AI-powered job discovery built for India.
records.description: ZapJobs is an AI-powered hiring platform built to make recruitment affordable, transparent, and efficient. Employers can post their first 10 jobs free and manage applications without spreadsheets or expensive plans. With intelligent candidate ranking and simple tracking tools, ZapJobs helps startups and SMEs hire faster while giving candidates real visibility and direct access to opportunities — without platform barriers.

records.name: CareConfirm
records.tagline: The smarter way to guarantee your appointments
records.description: Stop losing revenue to empty chairs. CareConfirm automates your scheduling, collects deposits, and slashes no-shows by 85%. Whether you’re a clinic, salon, or solo practitioner, turn your bookings into guaranteed income.
